description: Stills from the recording video, captured after each click, error and failed request plus an even spread. Pass at_s to see the screen at a moment (e.g. the time of an error from get_timeline), or from_s/to_s for a range. Returns up to 6 images.

at_s.description: Seconds from the start: returns the frames nearest this moment.

from_s.description: Start of a range in seconds.

recording.description: Traceo share link (e.g. https://www.traceo.dev/abc123...) or recording id.

to_s.description: End of a range in seconds.

name: get_frames
title: Get video frames
